boxfaces.py.summary: Draw boxes around the faces detected in a video.
details: Runs the OpenCV Haar cascade over every frame, draws a rectangle around each detected face and writes an MJPG-encoded copy of the video. Progress is reported every hundred frames.

build_setup.py.summary: Generate a ``setup.py`` for an existing package directory.
details: Finds the importable package inside the given folder (a directory with ``__init__.py`` or a single module file), scrapes ``__version__``/``__author__``/``__email__``/``__url__``/``__license__`` from ``__init__.py`` and writes a ready-to-run ``setup.py`` next to it that reads the README for the long description.

buildr.py.summary: Build a wheel for every ``setup.py`` found below the current directory.
details: Runs ``python setup.py bdist_wheel`` in the parent directory of each ``setup.py`` with a worker pool and finally lists the ``.whl`` files that were produced.

bw.py.summary: Classify an image as mostly dark, mostly bright or mixed from its average brightness.
details: Converts the image to RGB, weights the channels with the usual 0.299/0.587/0.114 luminance coefficients and reports the fraction of pixels below the dark threshold. The image counts as dark above 60% dark pixels and as bright below 40%.

calc.py.summary: Evaluate arithmetic expressions, either from the command line or in a Textual TUI.
details: With arguments the expression is evaluated once and printed (the exit status reports success); called without arguments a small full-screen calculator opens with the same parser behind its buttons.

ccss.py.summary: Shrink CSS files in place with ``cleancss`` and report the space that was freed.
details: Runs ``cleancss -O2`` (keeping only duplicate-rule removal) over the files named on the command line, or over every ``.css`` file below the current directory, skipping single-line files, and prints the size difference per file plus the total.

change_project_name.py.summary: Rename a project by replacing one string with another in file names and contents.
details: Walks the current directory, replaces the old text in every readable file and then renames the matching files and directories (deepest paths first, so parents can be renamed too). Existing destinations are reported instead of overwritten.

check_duplicate_packages.py.summary: Report Python packages installed both system-wide and in the user site directory.
details: Scans every ``site-packages`` directory known to :mod:`site`, matches packages by name across the system and user locations and prints the version of each copy, flagging version mismatches. Scanning of the two sets runs in parallel threads.

check_fname_conflict.py.summary: Flag ``.py`` file names that shadow a standard-library or installed third-party module.
details: Compares the stem of every Python file below the current directory against :data:`sys.stdlib_module_names` and against the distribution names listed in ``/sdcard/data/pip.txt`` (``pip freeze`` output), and exits with status 1 when a conflict is found.

check_funcs.py.summary: Check that the public functions, classes and constants of a package are exported in ``__init__.py``.
details: Parses each module of the package in the current directory, collects top-level definitions and compares them with the names imported or listed in ``__all__`` by ``__init__.py``. Missing names are printed per file and the exit status is 1 when something is not re-exported.

clean-bash.py.summary: Strip the comments (and blank lines) from bash scripts in place.
details: Finds comment tokens with tree-sitter's bash grammar, so ``#`` inside strings and here-documents is left alone, then rewrites the file without comment-only lines. ``--dry-run`` and ``--diff`` preview, ``--backup`` keeps a ``.bak`` copy.

clean-css.py.summary: Minify CSS files in place using tree-sitter, tinycss2 or csscompressor.
details: ``--backend`` selects the implementation: tree-sitter drops comments and whitespace without extra dependencies, tinycss2 and csscompressor are used when those packages are installed. ``--dry-run``/``--diff`` preview the result and ``--backup`` writes ``.bak`` copies.

clean-html.py.summary: Minify HTML files in place using tree-sitter or htmlmin.
details: With the default tree-sitter backend comments and inter-tag whitespace are removed; ``--backend htmlmin`` uses the htmlmin package (whitespace collapsing and attribute trimming) instead. ``--dry-run``/``--diff`` preview, ``--backup`` keeps a ``.bak`` copy.

clean-js.py.summary: Minify JavaScript files in place using tree-sitter, rjsmin or jsmin.
details: The tree-sitter backend removes comments and blank lines without third-party packages; ``--backend rjsmin`` or ``jsmin`` uses those minifiers when installed. ``--dry-run``/``--diff`` preview the output and ``--backup`` keeps a ``.bak`` copy.
